evidence.quote: the Committee clarified that it expects to maintain a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy for a considerable period after the economic recovery strengthens.
announcing that it will purchase agency mortgage-backed securities (MBS) at a pace of $40 billion per month
Consumer price inflation is running somewhat below the Federal Reserve's 2 percent longer-run objective
the pace of our recovery has been frustratingly slow
The Committee also judged that there were significant downside risks to this outlook
the Federal Reserve is providing additional monetary accommodation to achieve its dual mandate of maximum employment and price stability.

parsed.rationale: The speech defends and explains open-ended asset purchases and extended low-rate guidance, citing weak labor markets, subdued inflation, and downside risks. It also rebuts international criticism of accommodative policy, so the overall signal is strongly dovish.
